csv_project_name: Design for Airport Widen Runway 18/36 And Extend The Taxiway
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Chandler Airport Widen Runway 18/36 And Extend The Taxiway . The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to extend and widen Runway 18/36 and extend the taxiway. The existing runway pavement is exhibiting seasonal environmental distresses such as weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. The pavement is at a point where it is more cost effective to rehabilitate than let it deteriorate until a point where reconstruction is required. Rehabilitation will include an overlay. In addition to the rehabilitation, the runway and taxiway will be extended and widened to support larger business aircraft.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
